literal_gloss: Read-by-me of-Nonnosus history, in which he-treats embassy his to Ethiopians, Amerites, Saracens, strongest of-the then peoples, and to other eastern peoples. Justinian then the Roman administered state; phylarch of-the Saracens was Caisus, descendant of-Arethas, to whom himself phylarch being, to whom the of-Nonnosus grandfather was-ambassador from Anastasius then reigning sent, and peace arranged. Nay also the father of-Nonnosus (Abrames was his name) to Alamandarus phylarch of-Saracens was-ambassador, and two generals Roman, Timostratus and John, by-law of-war captured rescued; for Justin the king the of-the generals effected release. The Caisus to whom was-sent Nonnosus, of-two tribes ruled most-notable among Saracens, Chindeni and Maadeni. To this Caisus also the of-Nonnosus father, before Nonnosus as-ambassador to-be-chosen, Justinian sending was-sent and peaceful treaties made, so-as even the son of-Caisus (Mavias called) hostage to-take and to Justinian to Byzantium to-convey. After which time was-ambassador Nonnosus on two errands, Caisus if possible to emperor to-bring, or to the of-the Auxumites to-reach king (Elesbaas then ruled the people), or besides these even to the Amerites to-come. Auxumis city is greatest, as metropolis of whole Ethiopia, lying southerly and easterly of-the Roman rule. Nonnosus many plots of-peoples enduring, many of-beasts hardships along the road, and in many straits and impasses often falling, yet both what was-resolved accomplished and safe to homeland returned. Caïsus, Abrames again ambassador, to Byzantium comes, his phylarchy to brothers Ambrus and Izidus dividing, himself Palestine governorship from king received, multitude accompanying. Sandals now called arbylae ancients called, phakiolion phasolin. Saracens most, at Phoenicon and beyond Taurene mountains, holy place deem, where god released, twice yearly gather; one festival whole month measuring extends, mid-spring reckoned, sun in Taurus; other two months extends, after summer solstice; complete peace keep, with one-another and natives, beasts with men and each-other; other marvels myths no-different. Adulis from Auxumis fifteen days journey; journeying to Auxumis, Nonnosus and companions greatest spectacle saw near Aue (between Auxumites and Adulites), elephants near five thousand; grazed in great plain; to-approach them for natives was easy, nothing barring pasture; spectacle met them midway. Of airs blending speak: from Aue to Auxumis reversed; sun through Cancer Leo Virgo, to Aue summer drought holds air, from Aue winter fierce, from midday beginning, clouding air, violent rains flooding; Nile full overflows irrigates. Sun through Capricorn Aquarius Pisces reversed: Adulites to Aue rains flood, from Aue to Auxume summer and season-fruits land yields. From Pharsan sailing, Nonnosus to farthest island put-in, marvel to-hear: met human-shaped, smallest stature, black skin, hairy whole body; women like, children smaller; naked except small skin nakedness covering grown; nothing wild; human speech, dialect unknown to neighbours, more to Nonnosus party; lived off sea-oysters, fish cast-up; no courage, seeing men like-us cowered as we before greater beasts.
